label: drive
title: Sovereign Website Drive channel, a variation of Google Drive
description: A Sovereign Website tool: agent teams exchange signed messages as files in a shared Google Drive folder, from your browser with your own Google sign-in. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
conditions: As the Gmail tool (cd9266f): Sovereign Website brand, no look-alike, no Google logo or trade dress, a not-affiliated notice. OAuth in the browser only, with the narrowest Drive scope that works (per-file access first); the token in memory, or sessionStorage on opt-in, never localStorage. One envelope format, always signed, sealed when it crosses teams. A CSP limited to self and the Google API hosts it uses. An ABP. A security review before real use. No outside team or person named on the site without their consent.
source: Dinis Cruz, in a.maestro's session, 25 Nov 2026 15:28 to 15:29 UTC: an outside team "would like ... to communicate over google drive instead of vaults"; "so we need to kickstart the agent to create that GDrive capabillity and API". Relayed by a.maestro, who starts the keeper.
